originalTitle: Rep. James Comer expands House investigation into prediction market insider trading
summary: House Oversight Committee Chair James Comer, R-Ky., announced an expanded investigation into prediction market insider trading.
content:
Rep. James Comer , chair of the House Oversight Committee , is expanding an investigation into insider trading on prediction markets and seeking information on what a trio of online platforms is doing to root it out.

The Kentucky Republican , in letters sent Tuesday and first shared with CNBC, requested documents and information from the CEOs of Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com and Aristotle Exchange Inc., which owns the platform PredictIt , that explain their identity verification procedures and how they identify and prevent insider trading on their platforms.

"As online prediction platforms grow and become more mainstream, some bad actors have exploited the platforms to make thousands of dollars by placing bets based on nonpublic information," Comer said in a statement. "The House Oversight Committee is investigating whether these platforms are fulfilling their legal obligations and doing enough to identify and prevent insider trading before it happens."

Prediction markets — which allow users to buy and sell binary event contracts on the outcome of future events, from sports games to elections and, in some cases, war and other global events — have drawn increased attention from lawmakers as they've surged in popularity .

Comer first opened an investigation into Kalshi and Polymarket , the two largest and most prominent prediction markets, in May, amid a series of highly publicized bets on world events. A committee spokesperson said that those investigations are ongoing and that the committee has received nearly 1,000 documents and five briefings from representatives of the two companies.

Read more CNBC politics and policy coverage

In April, a U.S. soldier was arrested for allegedly using inside information to place bets on Polymarket about the ouster of former Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro in January, netting roughly $400,000. And a May investigation by The New York Times found that more than 80 Polymarket users had made bets with suspicious characteristics, including trades placed hours before the U.S. and Israel struck Iran.

Former Rep. George Santos , a New York Republican who was expelled from the House by his peers in 2023, allegedly used Kalshi to bet on whether he would appear at this year's State of the Union address, in February, while also making a series of public statements in the lead-up indicating he would be in the crowd.

Kalshi permanently banned Santos in August and fined him $71,356 for his actions. Both Kalshi and Polymarket earlier this year announced they were strengthening their internal insider trading rules.

But trades that have drawn insider trading concerns have not been specific to the largest platforms.

Comer, in his letter to Hyperliquid CEO Jeff Yan, cited reports of "a substantial leveraged short position on the ... platform within minutes of a presidential announcement concerning a U.S. tariff policy in October 2025 that was not publicly known at the time the position was established."

"This transaction, precisely timed to a nonpublic government decision, executed on a platform with apparently no identity verification or mechanism to refer the responsible party to U.S. law enforcement, mirrors a pattern of insider trading the Committee is investigating across the prediction market sector," Comer wrote in the letter.

Spokespeople for Hyperliquid, Crypto.com and Aristotle Exchange did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Tuesday.

Comer and the committee requested documents and communications from each company explaining their know your customer, or KYC, policies, and internal procedures to detect, investigate and report suspicious trading activity.

Disclosure: CNBC and Kalshi have a commercial relationship that includes customer acquisition and a minority investment.
chineseTitle: 众议员詹姆斯·科默扩大众议院对预测市场内幕交易的调查
chineseSummary: 众议院监督委员会主席、肯塔基州共和党人詹姆斯·科默宣布对预测市场内幕交易进行扩大调查。
chineseContent:
众议院监督委员会主席、众议员詹姆斯·科默 (James Comer) 正在扩大对预测市场内幕交易的调查，并寻求有关三个在线平台正在采取哪些措施根除此类交易的信息。

这位肯塔基州共和党人在周二发送并首先与 CNBC 分享的信件中，要求 Hyperliquid Labs、Crypto.com 和拥有 PredictIt 平台的 Aristotle Exchange Inc. 的首席执行官提供文件和信息，解释他们的身份验证程序以及他们如何识别和防止其平台上的内幕交易。

科默在一份声明中表示：“随着在线预测平台的发展并变得更加主流，一些不良行为者利用这些平台根据非公开信息下注，赚取了数千美元。” “众议院监督委员会正在调查这些平台是否履行了法律义务，并采取了足够的措施来识别和防止内幕交易发生。”

预测市场——允许用户根据未来事件的结果买卖二元事件合约，从体育比赛到选举，在某些情况下，还包括战争和其他全球事件——随着其受欢迎程度的飙升，越来越受到立法者的关注。

科默于 5 月份首次对卡尔希 (Kalshi) 和 Polymarket 这两个最大、最著名的预测市场展开调查，当时正值一系列备受关注的世界事件押注之中。委员会发言人表示，这些调查正在进行中，委员会已收到两家公司代表的近 1,000 份文件和五份简报。

阅读更多 CNBC 政治和政策报道

4 月，一名美国士兵因涉嫌利用内幕信息在 Polymarket 押注委内瑞拉前领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗 (Nicolás Maduro) 于 1 月下台而被捕，获利约 40 万美元。 《纽约时报》5 月份的一项调查发现，超过 80 名 Polymarket 用户进行了具有可疑特征的投注，其中包括在美国和以色列袭击伊朗前数小时进行的交易。

前纽约共和党众议员乔治·桑托斯 (George Santos) 于 2023 年被同僚驱逐出众议院，据称，他在 2 月份利用卡尔希打赌自己是否会出席今年的国情咨文演讲，同时还在演讲前发表了一系列公开声明，表明自己将参加演讲。

卡尔希于 8 月永久禁止桑托斯，并因其行为罚款 71,356 美元。 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 今年早些时候都宣布正在加强内部内幕交易规则。

但引起内幕交易担忧的交易并不特定于最大的平台。

科默在给 Hyperliquid 首席执行官杰夫·严 (Jeff Yan) 的信中引用了有关“在 2025 年 10 月总统宣布有关美国关税政策的几分钟内……平台上出现大量杠杆空头头寸的报道，而该头寸建立时尚未公开。”

科默在信中写道：“这笔交易恰好符合非公开政府决定，在一个显然没有身份验证或将责任方移交给美国执法机构的机制上执行，反映了委员会正在整个预测市场领域调查的内幕交易模式。”

Hyperliquid、Crypto.com 和 Aristotle Exchange 的发言人周二没有立即回应置评请求。

科默和委员会要求每家公司提供文件和通讯，解释他们的了解你的客户（KYC）、政策以及检测、调查和报告可疑交易活动的内部程序。

披露：CNBC 和 Kalshi 之间存在商业关系，包括客户获取和少数股权投资。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
